verdict.rationale: Expensify's docs show API credential issuance (partnerUserID/partnerUserSecret) and an OAuth2 authorization-code flow yielding short-lived access tokens, plus manual secret rotation — some least-privilege elements (time-limited tokens, credential regeneration) exist. However, there's no evidence of granular scopes, role-based permissions, or agent-specific credential restrictions (e.g., read-only vs. write, limited resource access) that would constitute true scoped/least-privilege credentials for an AI agent. Missing for 10: documented permission scopes/roles, agent-specific credential templates, and any explicit least-privilege API key configuration.
